text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, as we're walking through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? It seems pretty lively over there.

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, it's a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Can we?! Yeah, let's do it ri—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, we gotta get a raffle ticket first!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have to buy something from one of the shops to get one…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So let's buy enough snacks for a single ticket, hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so we acquire one raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We've only got one chance! Let's nab something great, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Praying for good luck, we grasp the raffle machine's lever together and turn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait… Whaaat?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um… Trainer? What should we do with this ticket?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! But we won it together…
choice_data_list: Take it and go on the trip with someone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Like anyone?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Got it. Could you hold onto the ticket for me in the meantime, then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We've got so much we need to work on right now, so this isn't the time to sit back and relax at a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please give it back to me when we've managed to get everything done!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I take Special Week's hot spring ticket for safekeeping.

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow! That hamburger steak looks so juicy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And the carrots are glistening… I just know it's gonna taste heavenly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, hamburger steak… That sure takes me back…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My mom would always make it for me whenever I had a tough day in the fields or had to shovel snow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Did I ever tell you how unbelievably tasty my mom's hamburger steak is when you're exhausted and your stomach is empty?
choice_data_list: The taste must bring back memories.
The taste must bring back memories.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yup! Memories of being with my mom…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So… Trainer! Let's share this hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna create unbelievably tasty memories with you too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, Special Week and I share an unbelievably tasty hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Awww, I wanted to eat the deluxe carrot hamburger steak…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait… Come to think of it, we've got a whole bunch of ingredients now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So we should just make our own hamburger steaks!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right?! All righty, let's go and buy the rest of the ingredients we need!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I wonder how many hamburger steaks we can make…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remind Special Week several times not to polish them all off in one day as we finish shopping and head back.

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A single carrot?! But what about the deluxe hamburger steak… or even the pile of carrots…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Well, I guess this is better than nothing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I gotta think positively!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll cherish this single carrot and devour it for the tasty morsel it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is slightly boosted by however much joy a single carrot can bring.

text_block_list.name: Lottery Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Awww, man…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Darn it… I really wanted to win something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both Special Week and I wallow in disappointment.
